join.purpose: Set up modules and settings, assign work, and read records and provenance from a terminal or a browser without the session holding project state.
join.function: Presents a menu chosen from the caller's nonce and folder context, and serves the same operations in a browser page.
join.observation: The command menu is built per invocation from the caller's context and is never stored.

join.purpose: Receive one bound assignment with its rendered prompt and inputs, work in a folder, and submit an answer that carries the delivered header.
join.function: Issues an eight-character nonce and a fixed submission header, and records each submission as a new revision.
join.observation: An assignment is addressed by nonce and refuses submissions once it is completed or aborted.

join.purpose: Add a command, operation, setting or subscription by declaring a Plugin, without touching chassis storage or chassis code.
join.function: Loads a declared Plugin from a module place and gives it public services under the caller's context.
join.observation: Every capability beyond the fixed chassis is delivered by a module.

join.purpose: Install a self-contained chassis with chosen modules and one project's seeded data, and run it without the source tree.
join.function: Builds a wheel carrying the core, the selected modules, their dependencies and a hash-checked seed manifest.
join.observation: A delivered artifact is never replaced by a later build.

join.purpose: Load, validate, run and stop every module as an owned task so that everything that plugs in is a module.
join.function: Discovers modules by place and disable list, validates each Plugin, and runs operations under a producer record and a bound context.
join.observation: A module loads only when its Plugin passes validation and its command names do not collide with chassis commands.

join.purpose: Keep one host process per data root so every front door shares state and in-flight work.
join.function: Serves length-prefixed requests over a private socket with an instance token, and starts the host on demand.
join.observation: Front doors are clients of one host and never own module state.

join.purpose: Give module authors one declared shape covering operations, commands, settings, subscriptions and lifecycle.
join.function: Defines the Plugin, Setting and Subscription declarations, the reserved chassis command names and the API version.
join.observation: A module whose api_version differs from the chassis version does not load.

join.purpose: Let modules reach storage, work, events, settings and other modules only through public services.
join.function: Exposes data, work, event, settings, modules and cli helpers that run under the calling context.
join.observation: Modules never open chassis storage directly.

join.purpose: Present only the commands valid for the caller's nonce, folder and entered module, and give a person a setup screen for modules and settings.
join.function: Builds the command group per invocation from the resolved context and re-checks visibility at execution.
join.observation: A supplied nonce that differs from the folder's bound nonce is an error.

entity.relation: stages settings and module edits for
entity.observation: Setup edits are previewed and applied through the same settings and module load operations the commands use.

join.purpose: Expose the agent's assignment, submit, status, operations, call, namespace and resolve tools over stdio, and register that door with the agent's own tooling.
join.function: Serves MCP tools that take a nonce on every call and speak to the runtime through a client.
join.observation: The nonce is never cached, so one server process serves several assignments.

join.purpose: Hand one unit of work to an agent by nonce, bind it to a working folder, and accept submissions that carry the delivered header.
join.function: Issues the nonce and header, marks the folder, records each submission and finishes as completed or aborted.
join.observation: The submission header is fixed when the assignment is issued.

join.purpose: Record each operation with its inputs, outputs, status and parent so any result can be traced to what produced it.
join.function: Writes production joins through a durable outbox and mirrors each output as a provenance join at the output's address.
join.observation: Inputs recorded after a producer has finished are ignored.

join.purpose: Keep every record as append-only revisions of joins under namespace addresses, per project, with one shared scope.
join.function: Stores joins in SQLite with a fixed name_length per address and idempotent puts, and can export and import them.
join.observation: A join is never overwritten, a new body is a new revision.

join.purpose: Keep module registration, settings, producers, jobs, events and assignments in one durable local database that survives the host.
join.function: Persists those tables under versioned migrations and recovers unfinished work when the host starts.
join.observation: A database written by a newer schema than the runtime knows is refused.

join.purpose: Let a person use the chassis from a page with login, project selection, module pages and the workflow editor.
join.function: Serves an ASGI application that mounts the pages other modules contribute.
join.observation: Contributed pages attach only when the module that provides them is active.

entity.observation: Each explorer panel can be flipped to the exact envelope an agent would receive.

join.purpose: Author workflows as namespace joins and run them as durable multi-step flows that issue rendered prompts, run tools and branch on answers.
join.function: Pins definitions by revision, issues one assignment per step, and resumes without duplicating issued or output joins.
join.observation: A run issues from exact step revisions, never the latest ones.

join.purpose: Turn an issued assignment into an external agent process and retain how it ended.
join.function: Starts a configured command in a new process group, sends the prompt, nonce and header on stdin, and submits the answer if none arrived.
join.observation: Every terminal state of a launch is retained before it is announced.

join.purpose: Snapshot an artifact folder by content so an origin and its variants can be rebuilt exactly without Git.
join.function: Stores immutable content-addressed payloads and records origins, variants and lineage as joins.
join.observation: Variants are siblings against one origin baseline and are never stacked on each other.

join.purpose: Deliver the chassis, chosen modules and one project's data as an installable artifact that runs on its own.
join.function: Computes the reachable closure, copies dependencies, hashes every seed file, and builds the archive with a fresh identity.
join.observation: Files that change during export abort the build.

join.purpose: Assemble selectable context over the namespace for an object and keep agent memory as revisions that can be updated and deleted without losing history.
join.function: Computes visibility by dependency reachability and returns the contributions selected for an address.
join.observation: Reading context is a projection and never rewrites stored history.

entity.observation: Updating a memory writes a new revision and deleting it writes a deleted marker.

join.purpose: Keep a project's foundation model as immutable revisions with a head, in a knowledge service that applies each request once.
join.function: Publishes content-digested snapshots, refuses a stale base, and answers through a local HTTP knowledge service.
join.observation: Identical content reuses the identical revision.

join.purpose: Discover command groups from module manifests and hide them by mode, binding and condition for the earlier project-scoped front door.
join.function: Reads manifests from the shipped, home, project and configured places and records duplicates as errors.
join.observation: A manifest whose command key collides is dropped and recorded.

join.purpose: Show module authors every service a module can use, with the smallest working module.
join.function: Exercises writes, joins, revisions, events, prompts, jobs, assignments and settings visibility through the public contract only.
join.observation: An example module imports only the public contract and services.

join.purpose: Prove the chassis and modules behave as designed, in isolated homes, installed artifacts and real browsers.
join.function: Runs unit, installed-artifact and browser checks against an isolated data root with no modules installed by default.
join.observation: Each test starts with an empty data root and no installed modules.

join.purpose: Host the plugin runtime and serve its invoke, spawn, publish, load, unload, finalize and read methods to clients.
join.function: Runs one Runtime in the host process and answers each request with the caller's context bound.
join.observation: Accepted invocations finish even when the requesting client disconnects.

join.purpose: Reject a module whose Plugin, static dependencies, OS support, API version or command names are wrong, and roll back a partial load.
join.function: Declares the fields and reserved names the runtime validates against.
join.observation: Module metadata is read statically and the module is not imported to read it.

join.purpose: Persist module registration, settings, jobs and events so state survives a host restart.
join.function: Provides versioned tables and recovery at host start.
join.observation: Jobs are persisted rows that outlive the task that runs them.

join.purpose: Open a producer for every operation and close it as completed, failed or cancelled.
join.function: Begins and finishes producer records around each owned task.
join.observation: Every operation runs as an owned task with a producer record.

join.purpose: Refuse new work on an assignment that is finalizing, completed or aborted, and settle its other jobs before it is closed.
join.function: Reports assignment status and finishes assignments durably.
join.observation: Finalizing an assignment waits for the assignment's remaining jobs to settle.

join.purpose: Run a module's operation, job or event publication in the host, not in the calling process.
join.function: Provides a client that forwards invoke, spawn and publish to the host.
join.observation: A module cannot select a project or nonce different from the one it is bound to.

join.purpose: Read and write namespace joins for the current project and observe every read as an input of the current producer.
join.function: Places joins per project and shared scope and refuses writes to the shared scope.
join.observation: Writes are project-only and reads of the shared scope are allowed.

join.purpose: Issue, read, submit and finish assignments from module code under the calling context.
join.function: Wraps assignment operations and refuses an assignment that belongs to another module or project.
join.observation: An operation bound to a nonce cannot select a different nonce.

join.purpose: Reach the shared host from every invocation and start it when absent.
join.function: Connects a client, starts a detached host under a start lock, and waits for it to answer.
join.observation: Only one host instance runs per data root.

join.purpose: Let an agent or person assign, begin, submit, complete and abort work from the command line.
join.function: Provides nonce-keyed assignment operations.
join.observation: A folder is bound to at most one nonce at a time.

join.purpose: Show the agent its assignment and take its submission with the delivered header.
join.function: Provides assignment, submit, status, complete and abort by nonce.
join.observation: An agent that finishes a submission through the door is not overwritten by a driver fallback.

join.purpose: Run the assigned module's operations for the agent, in the foreground or as a job.
join.function: Connects a client to the host and calls operations under the assignment's context.
join.observation: Only operations available for the assignment are listed to the agent.

join.purpose: Give each assignment and each submission its own producer so the work and its answers are traceable.
join.function: Creates producers and production joins.
join.observation: Each submission is a new producer and a new join reference.

join.purpose: Index assignments, delivered context and submissions for fast lookup by nonce.
join.function: Provides assignment, context and submission tables.
join.observation: The delivered prompt, bindings and header are stored as an immutable snapshot at issue.

join.purpose: Mirror each assignment as a versioned join at the address of its prompt revision.
join.function: Stores the mirror as a project join.
join.observation: Assignment state can be rebuilt from retained joins.

join.purpose: Keep production records and provenance mirrors as ordinary joins in the shared scope when no project applies.
join.function: Accepts production joins at the data.provenance address.
join.observation: Provenance is stored in the same store as the results it describes.

join.purpose: Stage a production record in the scheduler's transaction and flush it later, so a failed write never leaves a half record.
join.function: Provides an outbox table that is flushed under a lock.
join.observation: A rejected write deletes its outbox row and re-raises.

join.purpose: Offer a terminal page inside the browser interface.
join.function: Answers the contribution event with a provider file and factory that mounts routes and menu entries.
join.observation: A contributing module's pages are removed and its imports purged when the module deactivates.

join.purpose: Preview, save, issue and answer workflows from an editor page and import or export them as markdown, XML and JSON.
join.function: Forwards each editor action to the workflow operations when that module is enabled.
join.observation: The editor reports itself unavailable when the workflow module is not enabled.

join.purpose: Draw the namespace as a graph whose nodes and edges are current joins, with nothing inferred.
join.function: Projects current-revision joins of collected node, attachment and edge types.
join.observation: An edge whose target has no collected node stays as an unresolved note and is not drawn.

join.purpose: Run every request through a named module operation on the host, never through its own storage.
join.function: Connects a runtime client and a module connection.
join.observation: Browser control routes require an instance bearer token, separate from browser sessions.

join.purpose: Run a configured shell command in a pseudo-terminal as an owned job, for a local terminal or a browser.
join.function: Submits a job and connects to it over a one-use token on a loopback port.
join.observation: A browser session survives a page reload and ends on stop, module removal or web shutdown.

join.purpose: Issue each prompt step as an assignment and seal or submit its answer.
join.function: Assigns and submits under a nonce with deterministic issued and output join ids.
join.observation: A submission under a nonce must belong to the current assignment's prompt revision.

join.purpose: Drive pending prompt steps to an answer without a person relaying them.
join.function: Executes an assignment with a chosen provider or command and leaves advancing to the caller.
join.observation: Launching does not advance the assignment, the workflow does.

join.purpose: Retain definitions, steps, runs, issued prompts, outputs and provenance as joins.
join.function: Stores workflow joins under workflow addresses.
join.observation: Run reads refuse a run that belongs to another project.

join.purpose: Render object bindings in prompts from the knowledge selected for each object and record every included reference as an input.
join.function: Returns view, visibility and selected contributions for an address.
join.observation: A binding that needs selector or saved knowledge controls fails when the knowledge module is absent, and an ordinary binding still works.

join.purpose: Author and edit workflows in markdown, XML or JSON and prepare an imported source into a runnable definition.
join.function: Converts between formats without executing and without inferring roles.
join.observation: Format conversion is lossless and never executes a workflow.

join.purpose: Turn the answer of an intake or inference run into namespace objects and joins after it is submitted.
join.function: Materializes answers as intake objects, joins and provenance, and records diagnostics.
join.observation: Diagnostics never gate or replace an answer.

join.purpose: Give the preparation agent the grammar of runnable workflows and the source with its aliases in one prompt.
join.function: Supplies the execution grammar and preparation instructions.
join.observation: A preparation answer is imported only when its structural diagnostics are empty.

join.purpose: Keep the exact answer as a source join and every collected object and join as its own join at its address.
join.function: Writes intake source, object, join, provenance and account joins.
join.observation: Objects under combined or subtype elements are flagged inactive and kept.

join.purpose: Record parse, name_length and namespace conflict findings beside an answer for later observation.
join.function: Returns findings as data and never raises on an answer.
join.observation: An answer with unexpected or missing fields is still kept.

join.purpose: Publish the expanded contribution of an intake run as a foundation revision for the earlier front door.
join.function: Expands a coarse contribution into types, elements, bindings, narrowings and joins and publishes it with an expected base.
join.observation: A contribution's gaps and extras become recorded diagnostics and nothing is rejected.

join.purpose: Compare an answer to its registered schema and return findings with a path, code and message.
join.function: Provides schemas that are bundled into one self-contained schema for an external agent.
join.observation: An unregistered schema yields one finding and no failure.

join.purpose: Compose an assignment's prompt from the role's source prompt and component texts, keeping authored edits.
join.function: Supplies role prompts and shared component texts.
join.observation: A stored prompt is upgraded only when its text still equals a known managed revision.

join.purpose: Attach the semantic rules chosen for the role as revisioned snapshots.
join.function: Supplies the rulebook records.
join.observation: Each rule snapshot carries a revision.

join.purpose: Give the agent one self-contained output schema with its assignment.
join.function: Supplies the referenced schemas.
join.observation: The bundled schema inlines every schema it references.

join.purpose: Deliver the assignment to the process and take its answer through the delivered header.
join.function: Provides assign, submit and process tracking by nonce.
join.observation: The launched process receives the nonce and header in its environment and on stdin.

join.purpose: Give the launched agent the assignment tools when the module that serves them is available.
join.function: Returns a server descriptor for a nonce.
join.observation: A launch works without the door and falls back to standard input and output.

join.purpose: Keep file contents once by digest and verify them on every read.
join.function: Provides an atomic, hash-verified content store.
join.observation: A stored payload is immutable and named by its sha256.

join.purpose: Record origins, variants and lineage as joins so history moves with the namespace.
join.function: Stores artifact origin, variant and lineage joins.
join.observation: Import keeps exact references and records a divergence as a new lineage join.

join.purpose: Bundle only the global objects and joins reachable from the selected project and list what could not be resolved.
join.function: Walks typed references and returns a closure with unresolved reasons.
join.observation: An unresolved reference is reported and is not fatal.

join.purpose: Carry recorded payloads in the delivered artifact.
join.function: Reads payloads by digest.
join.observation: Every seed file is listed with its sha256, mode and destination.

join.purpose: Load the delivered modules as installed modules when the artifact runs.
join.function: Serves the packaged module folder as the installed place.
join.observation: A module marked incompatible stops the build.

join.purpose: Keep layers, selections, masks, attachments and memories as joins.
join.function: Provides a single consistent snapshot to query.
join.observation: An attachment is hidden when a join it depends on is hidden or missing.

join.purpose: Decide which properties apply to an address by origin, and show the rest as summary.
join.function: Provides applicability with a path, freshness and diagnostics.
join.observation: Backward visibility edges are never used as forward origins.

join.purpose: Carry knowledge to a new model revision with a decision for each attachment.
join.function: Returns preserve, relocate, regenerate, reconsider or invalidate for each attachment.
join.observation: Authored attachments are never regenerated.

join.purpose: Read a published revision as deterministic, paginated, address-based projections that report the records they depended on.
join.function: Provides an indexed snapshot of a revision.
join.observation: Each read reports dependency fingerprints so staleness can be detected later.

join.purpose: Apply an explicit structural patch as a new revision, rebase onto a moved head and report conflicts.
join.function: Publishes with an expected base.
join.observation: A relocation moves the whole branch and keeps the old address as an alias.

join.purpose: Resolve a patch's targets and compute the impact of a change on attached knowledge.
join.function: Resolves addresses by id, alias and name and reports ambiguity as a diagnostic.
join.observation: An ambiguous or unresolved target is reported as a diagnostic.

join.purpose: Read the shipped command groups and the guide for the earlier front door.
join.function: Supplies module manifests with handlers and input schemas.
join.observation: Launcher command names are reserved and a group that uses one is dropped.

join.purpose: Serve commands against a project's model through the knowledge service.
join.function: Provides model operations to command handlers.
join.observation: The knowledge service refuses to serve when its runtime fingerprint differs from the caller's.

join.purpose: Show the declared shape by using every part of it.
join.function: Defines what a Plugin may contain.
join.observation: A copied example builds as its own package that depends only on the chassis.

join.purpose: Show the public services in use, including a request and response pair over the event bus.
join.function: Provides data, work, event and settings services.
join.observation: A response is stored only when a responder module is loaded.

join.purpose: Check delivered artifacts outside the source tree for installed entry points, module removal, shutdown and retained data.
join.function: Builds artifacts and runs their delivered commands.
join.observation: Installed-artifact checks run with an interpreter that is not the editable source environment.

join.purpose: Check the pages in a real browser, including the graph camera, jobs, workflow editor and login.
join.function: Serves pages that a browser driver can open.
join.observation: Browser checks start their own server against a fixture data root.
